Sales CRM: deals, persons, organizations, activities and pipelines.

## API key

1. Open [app.pipedrive.com](https://app.pipedrive.com/settings/api) and create an API key with only the access your apps need.
2. Copy it. It may be shown only once.

**What to create:** A personal API token from Settings > Personal preferences > API in Pipedrive.

Add it to your Gateway. It asks for the key:

```bash
everyapp provider add pipedrive
```

### Use it in an app

In the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  pipedrive: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

The app calls Pipedrive's [API](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1) with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. Use `"write"` if the app changes things. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

**Check it worked:** `everyapp provider show pipedrive` shows the key as set.

**Cost:** Each endpoint spends API tokens from a daily company budget of 30,000 x plan multiplier (1 to 7) x seats.

**Rate limits:** Per API token: 20 (Lite) to 120 (Ultimate) requests per 2 seconds; Search 10 per 2 seconds.

Something wrong or missing? [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Pipedrive).
